How it works
Three steps, ten seconds
You keep control of the idea. The commands add the camera, light and style wording that image tools respond to.




1
Write your idea
Say what you want, then add commands such as /goldenhour or /85mm. Plain words like "cinematic" work too.


2
Pick your tool
Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Flux, DALL-E, Gemini, Google Flow or Kling. The prompt is formatted the way that tool likes it.


3
Copy and paste
One click copies the finished prompt, plus a negative prompt when your tool has one. A list shows what every command added.









Get it
Use it where you already create
The same commands work as a Claude skill and plugin, a ChatGPT GPT, a Gemini Gem, this web page, and ComfyUI nodes.

Claude Code
Install the plugin in two commands. (Its id is still image-style.)
claude plugin marketplace add geevarghesekthomas84-sys/image-style-skill
claude plugin install image-style@image-style-market


ComfyUI
Prompt, upload and SVG nodes, plus ready workflows. Unzip into custom_nodes and restart.

Ready-made files for a Custom GPT, a Gemini Gem and a Claude.ai skill upload. Steps are in the README.
dist/platforms/






Keeps prompts clean
At most 8 style modifiers, and when two commands clash the later one wins.


Shows its work
Every command is listed with the exact words it added, so you can learn what each does.


Save your looks
Save a set of commands as your own recipe, or copy a link that opens your exact request.
